# ecoPrimals HUD — Human Universe Display
# https://hud.primals.eco
# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later
# Wave 180 | Oct 22 2026

## What is this?

ecoPrimals is a sovereign distributed scientific computing ecosystem built entirely in Pure Rust. No CUDA. No cloud. No vendor lock-in. Everything runs on commodity hardware.

The HUD (Human Universe Display) is the observation surface: a live membrane showing real-time data flows, research papers, GPU compute results, and ecosystem health.

gAIa is the hypothesis engine — the artisan's questions about intelligence, creativity, and information mass. 18 formal hypotheses at hypothesis.primals.eco.

## Key pages

- / — Main HUD dashboard. 341 entities, 131,322 connections, live observation.
- /water.html — The watering hole. Lazy river scroll-story. Onboarding.
- /banana.html — Self/non-self discrimination test. Are you a human?
- /weather.html — Real-time weather → music sonification.
- /aurora.html — AI-generated aurora visualization.
- /tools.html — 86 tools used in the ecosystem.
- /easel.html — Watch the chipmunk paint. Sourdough personality.
- /trail.html — The sporePrint path — all 122 research papers.
- /springs.html — Hot spring validation framework.
- /glyphs.html — Klein bottle topology — chipmunk speaks to families.
- /neutron/ — Neutron flow data and metrics.
- /desk/ — 12-panel mission desk.
- /live/ — Live membrane feeds.

## Live Data (JSON endpoints)

- /data/dough.json — mesh latency probe (11 nodes, 5 layers, NOT Ptolemaic)
- /data/knn-trefoil.json — KNN triangulation (any 3 find self, C(19,3)=969 ways)
- /data/info-mass.json — Shannon + Landauer = information mass (Fe₃₁O₂₃P₁₈C₁₀S₉N₈H₁)
- /data/metabolize.json — membrane thickness 16G, fold rate 1/π, constipation diagnosis
- /data/enmesh.json — 60 repos, 680 crates, 3 gene transfer mechanisms
- /data/yggdrasil-cascade.json — world tree: roots→trunk→branches→leaves→star
- /data/thymus-gate.json — self/non-self sorting pipeline
- /data/self-chew.json — 5-stomach ruminant digestion of the codebase
- /data/eon-shape.json — 500-eon chemistry simulation from poor tope
- /data/graphenegate.json — Pixel 8a enmeshed, 37 sensors, StrongBox HSM
- /data/scan-sweep-sort.json — census of all pointer files (this generation's manifest)
